Minimizing across sign choices and vertices gives precisely 1-||y||_1-||y||_infinity; strict positivity is equivalent to projections in all facet interiors. Edge normal-cone inequalities simultaneously reduce to ||y||_1+||y||_infinity<=1, and all six vertex normals occur throughout int(O). In strict interior of Sigma3 the 6+12+8 distinct base points give 26, and a boundary facet-edge collision prevents 26 at equality; outside some facet foot is inactive. Independently integrated the chamber 0<=z<=y<=x, 2x+y+z<=1 symbolically to 1/144; 48 chambers give vol Sigma3=1/3, while vol O=4/3, yielding exactly 1/4. Independently verified facet barycentric minima for representative rational interior, exterior and boundary points. No claim about other octahedra or full count distribution.
